items.context:
Why did nobody tell me I could have such adorable mods on Stardew Valley?!? #stardewvalley #gaming #cozygames
image, no description
items.text: Mods are a fun rabbit hole with Stardew. One small tip: copy your save folder somewhere safe before adding any, so you can always go back.

items.author: goldenhourmaya.bsky.social
items.context: halloween game night: spooky horror game with the lights off, or cozy farming sim under a blanket? 👻🎮 #gaming #halloween
items.text: Cozy farming sim under a blanket, easy. Stardew Valley even has a Spirit's Eve festival in fall, so it fits the night nicely.

items.author: vilegentleman.bsky.social
items.context: I mean, how long has Skyrim been out and I still play consistently? 😂 Same with Stardew. But Bloomtown, man. I love it! It's like Stardew x Persona. I'm near the end of the game and just stretching it out dragging time.
items.text: Stardew x Persona is a lovely pitch. Stretching out the last stretch of a game you love is a very real feeling.

items.author: catrector.com
items.context: I want to play a new game but I do *not* know what I want What have you been loving in the last year? Previous loves are - Long Dark - Stardew - Inscryption - Bg3 - Silent Hill f - Layers of Fear
items.text: Dredge might fit. It's a calm fishing and exploring game that slowly turns eerie, so it sits somewhere between Stardew and Inscryption.
